CustomField.formula:
IF( AND ( SBQQ__PricebookId__c = '01s7V000000NyMZQA0', OR(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Type, "Renewal"),Renewal_Roll_up_Amount__c > 0)), "MSP Renewal;", "") &
IF(AND(SBQQ__PricebookId__c <> '01s7V000000NyMZQA0',OR(Total_ESR_Discount__c > 0,Total_Hardware_Discount__c > 0, Total_Training_Discount__c > 0)),"Non-software Score;", "") &
IF(AND(SBQQ__PricebookId__c= '01s7V000000NyMZQA0',Ignore_Partner_Margin__c = TRUE),"Non-standard MSP discounting;", "") &
IF( AND(SBQQ__PricebookId__c <> '01s7V000000NyMZQA0', Partner_Discretionary_Discount__c = True), "Partner Discretionary Discount;", "")&
IF( AND(OR(AND(ADI_SKU_Count__c > 0 && ADI_SKU_Count__c < 2500, SDM_SKU_Count__c > 0 && SDM_SKU_Count__c < 2500), AND(SCRM_SKU_Count__c > 0, SCRM_SKU_Count__c <5000)), AND(OR(Account_Type__c = "Prospect", Account_Type__c = "Former Customer"),Sales_Ops_Derived_EP__c < 10000)),"Below Bundle EP Minimum;", "") &
IF( OR (AND( SBQQ__PricebookId__c = '01s7V000000NyMZQA0', TEXT( End_User_Account__r.Type ) <> "Customer", TEXT(Deployment_Method__c)= "Taas", Max_Bundle_Quantity__c < 500), AND ( SBQQ__PricebookId__c = '01s7V000000NyMZQA0', TEXT( End_User_Account__r.Type ) <> "Customer", TEXT(Deployment_Method__c)<> "Taas", Max_Bundle_Quantity__c < 300),AND(SBQQ__PricebookId__c = '01s7V000000NyMZQA0',Max_Bundle_Quantity__c < 100)), "Below EP Minimum;", "") &
IF(AND(SBQQ__PricebookId__c = '01s7V000000NyMZQA0',Max_Bundle_Quantity__c > 10000 ), "MSP over 10k EPs;", "") &
IF(AND(SBQQ__PricebookId__c <> '01s7V000000NyMZQA0',OR(Renewal_Roll_up_Amount__c > 0, TEXT(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Type)= "Renewal")), "Renewal Opportunity", "") &
IF(TEXT(PaymentTypeNew__c) = 'Custom',"Custom Billing;", "") &
IF(Opportunity_Type__c = "Consulting","Consulting SKU;", "") &
IF(BurstingCount__c >=1,"Burst Product;", "") &
IF(FOC_Count__c >=1 ,"Free of Charge Product;", "" )&
IF(Max_Trial_Term_Rollup__c > 6, "Trial Term greater than 6 mos;","") &
IF(Restricted_SKUs__c > 0,"Contains Restricted SKU;", "" )&
IF(Payment_Term_Override__c = TRUE,"Payment Term Override;", "")&
IF(Account_Contracted_Price__c > 0,"Account has Contractual Pricing;", "" )&
IF(OR( AND(No_of_End_Points_Quote_Score__c <= 20000, Chronicle_Discount__c >= 0.35), AND(No_of_End_Points_Quote_Score__c > 20000, No_of_End_Points_Quote_Score__c <= 100000, Chronicle_Discount__c >= 0.55), AND(No_of_End_Points_Quote_Score__c > 100000 , Chronicle_Discount__c >= 0.60)),"Chronicle Discount;","")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Non-Standard quote elements requiring Deal Desk to approve
CustomField.label: Approval Reason
